name.value: New York New York Greek Restaurant

description.value: New York New York Greek Restaurant is a family-owned sit-down Greek restaurant in Surrey operating since 1999, serving authentic dishes made with ingredients imported directly from Greece. The kitchen is known for hand-cut calamari, souvlaki hot off the grill, Roast Lamb a L'Astoria, and house-made moussaka, with meals served in courses. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, delivery, catering, and private events for up to 100 guests, with free parking on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms this is an operating Greek restaurant at Unit 301, 6361 152 St, Surrey, BC V3S 3K8, with phone 604-572-4222. The site confirms dine-in, takeout, and delivery options, extensive vegetarian/vegan/GF-friendly items (falafel marked vegan, vegetarian moussaka, spanakopita, GF-friendly falafel bites), and a full bar. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant confirmed via a fully accessible website with current menus, hours, and contact details. Free on-site parking noted; a legitimate Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM record has no address, phone, or tags populated; all contact details sourced from website.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly lists falafel as vegan, vegetarian moussaka with lentils/zucchini/eggplant, spanakopita, grilled halloumi, and Greek salad as vegetarian options. Falafel bites are noted as 'gluten-free friendly' on both lunch and dinner menus
